name: English Wikipedia, league-season and team-season articles
acquisition: fetched 2026-09-07; raw API responses with revision ids cached in pgm3-sources/wiki_cache
scope: Stage B (Arena) and Stage C (CFL) plus WFL, AAF, USFL 2022-, XFL, UFL -- the leagues Stage A never reached. Standings, head coaches, club-season records, results, and every man the archive does not hold.

RANK.position: BELOW media guides and contemporary newspapers, as declarations/wikipedia.json already rules for player articles.
RANK.why: user-edited; infobox facts are effectively uncited (measured 6.7% of infoboxes carry any reference), prose ~48% cited.

ATTRIBUTION.rule: every fact carries the article title AND the revision id AND its timestamp. A Wikipedia fact without a revision id is not attributable: the page will change.
ATTRIBUTION.cited: every fact records whether an inline <ref> sits on the value or its table row. Cited and uncited must stay distinguishable in the store.

CLUBS.rule: every club string is resolved through build/clubs.json (src/clubs.py Clubs.resolve, with the season year and league). An unresolved string is kept AS PRINTED with the resolver's reason; nothing is guessed.
CLUBS.arena: MEASURED 2026-09-07: build/clubs.json holds no Arena club and the person index holds no Arena league key. Every Arena club string will be a refusal until the club table learns the league. That is a finding, recorded, not a parser failure.

head_coach_match: club-year evidence: the candidate holds a season key at that club and year (COACHES|y{year}|{code}, or any league key at that code and year) -> method club-year
otherwise, a unique name in the person universe AND a coaching history (any COACHES| key) -> method name-unique+coach-history
otherwise NO MATCH: the coach is a LEAD. A unique name alone is not identity -- the promotion check caught a second Red Grange.
IDENTITY.pre_1950: before era_cut (1950) only club-year evidence matches; declarations/wikipedia.json IDENTITY applies.
IDENTITY.leads_are_not_people: an unmatched coach is written as a lead with everything needed for a later ruling (name as printed, league, year, club, article, revision). Nothing is promoted here. The promotion check refused 350 last time; it stays a ruling.
IDENTITY.no_claims_for_unmatched: an unmatched man produces no claims at all.

DISAGREEMENTS_ARE_HELD.rule: where Wikipedia's head coach differs from the archive's (COACHES| season keys with is_head_coach), BOTH stay, both attributed; the disagreement is counted by league and field and written in full.
DISAGREEMENTS_ARE_HELD.no_counterpart: the archive holds no standings or results for any league, so those facts have nothing to disagree with; they are recorded as new, attributed facts and counted as such. For Arena there is no counterpart of any kind.

OUTPUT.claims: person-subject claims only (wikipedia.head_coach), so every existing consumer that globs build/*.json for claims reads them unchanged
OUTPUT.club_seasons: standings rows and team-season records/results live under `club_seasons`, NOT under `claims`: the store's subject vocabulary is person/stint/person_season and no consumer expects a club subject
